fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.architectures

Class RTArchitecture

  • java.lang.Object
    • fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.architectures.Architecture
      • fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.architectures.RTArchitecture
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ArchitectureI, java.io.Serializable

    public class RTArchitecture
extends Architecture
    The class RTArchitecture extends an DEVS simulation architecture by adding its real time simulation property.

    Description

    Implementation Invariants

     invariant       !isComplete() || atomicModelDescriptors.values().stream().allMatch(amd -> amd.isRealTimeModelDescriptor())
 invariant       !isComplete() || coupledModelDescriptors.values().stream().allMatch(cmd -> cmd.isRealTimeModelDescriptor())
 invariant       accelerationFactor > 0.0

    Invariants

     invariant       true        // no more invariant

    Created on : 2020-12-16

    Author:
    Jacques Malenfant
    See Also:

      Fields 
      Modifier and Type Field and Description
      protected double accelerationFactor
      the acceleration/deceleration factor that adjusts the pace of the simulation upon the real physical time; a value greater than 1 will force the simulation to run faster in real time than the simulated time, while a value under 1 forces it to run slower.

    • Constructor Detail

      • RTArchitecture

        public RTArchitecture(java.lang.String rootModelURI,
                      java.util.Map<java.lang.String,AbstractAtomicModelDescriptor> atomicModelDescriptors,
                      java.util.Map<java.lang.String,CoupledModelDescriptor> coupledModelDescriptors,
                      java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit simulationTimeUnit)
        create a real time model architectural description given the parameters.

        Contract

         pre     architectureURI != null && !architectureURI.isEmpty()
 pre     rootModelURI != null && !rootModelURI.isEmpty()
 pre     atomicModelDescriptors != null
 pre     coupledModelDescriptors != null
 pre     atomicModelDescriptors.containsKey(rootModelURI) || coupledModelDescriptors.containsKey(rootModelURI)
 pre     simulationTimeUnit != null
 post    true        // no postcondition.
        Parameters:
        rootModelURI - URI of the root model in this architecture.
        atomicModelDescriptors - map from atomic model URIs to their respective descriptor.
        coupledModelDescriptors - map from coupled model URIs to their respective descriptor.
        simulationTimeUnit - time unit used by all simulation clocks in the architecture.

      • RTArchitecture

        public RTArchitecture(java.lang.String architectureURI,
                      java.lang.String rootModelURI,
                      java.util.Map<java.lang.String,AbstractAtomicModelDescriptor> atomicModelDescriptors,
                      java.util.Map<java.lang.String,CoupledModelDescriptor> coupledModelDescriptors,
                      java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit simulationTimeUnit,
                      double accelerationFactor)
        create a real time model architectural description given the parameters.

        Contract

         pre     architectureURI != null && !architectureURI.isEmpty()
 pre     rootModelURI != null && !rootModelURI.isEmpty()
 pre     atomicModelDescriptors != null
 pre     coupledModelDescriptors != null
 pre     atomicModelDescriptors.containsKey(rootModelURI) || coupledModelDescriptors.containsKey(rootModelURI)
 pre     simulationTimeUnit != null
 pre     atomicModelDescriptors.values().stream().allMatch(amd -> amd.isRealTimeModelDescriptor())
 pre     coupledModelDescriptors.values().stream().allMatch(cmd -> cmd.isRealTimeModelDescriptor())
 pre     accelerationFactor > 0.0
 post    true        // no postcondition.
        Parameters:
        architectureURI - URI of this simulation architecture.
        rootModelURI - URI of the root model in this architecture.
        atomicModelDescriptors - map from atomic model URIs to their respective descriptor.
        coupledModelDescriptors - map from coupled model URIs to their respective descriptor.
        simulationTimeUnit - time unit used by all simulation clocks in the architecture.
        accelerationFactor - the acceleration factor between the simulation clock and the real time.
